🆕 What's New
▸
COBC Dispatch · Bergen County Chaverim
Live Operation
🎖️ Command Mode ACTIVE
An operation is running. Open the live map to watch, make new calls, and assign units.
Admin Tools
🎖️ Command Mode Off
Big multi-call events (flood night). Added members share live location; make, assign & complete calls from a live map. Runs alongside normal dispatch.
🔍 Missing Person Off
Grid search: subject profile + photo, last-seen pin, auto search grid, member breadcrumb trails, and draw-on-map.
📚 Command Center Logs
Every past command / search operation — the full notes & activity log for each incident, re-sendable by WhatsApp or email.
🧪 Test Mode OFF
While ON, every new call is marked a test and never counts in stats. Turn OFF for real dispatching.
📜 Audit Log
▸
Who created, changed, completed, or deleted each call.
🔍
💾 Backup & Restore
A snapshot of all calls + equipment is saved to the cloud automatically once a day (kept 30 days). You can also download a backup file now, or restore from one if data is ever lost.
🗑️ Reset All Calls
Wipes every call from the shared database — see the clean day-one state. Testing mode: reusable.
📍 Common Locations
▸
Hard-to-address spots (gas stations, stores, schools) that appear in the New Call → 📍 Common Calls list for everyone.
